notes:
New look: your Final Cut audio is wired to Pro Tools track groups like a patchbay. Click a role, then a group, to re-route it.
New Preflight panel checks every export before it's written and explains what's wrong with a one-click fix. It catches camera scratch audio going out alongside your sound recorder (the cause of distorted, duplicate dialogue tracks), offline media, muted clips and more.
Themes: Blackout (dark) or Paper (light), under Appearance.
